title: 9 Day Kenya Fly-in Safari: Samburu, Ol Pejeta, Mara and Amboseli
rank_math_title: Kenya Fly-in Safari: 9 Amazing Days in Four Parks
rank_math_desc: Kenya fly-in safari for 9 days: Samburu, Ol Pejeta, the Masai Mara and Amboseli, linked by flights and one short road transfer. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya fly-in safari covers four of the country's best wildlife areas in nine days, from the dry north to the foot of Kilimanjaro.
overview:
This Kenya fly-in safari is our most complete fly-in route. It visits Samburu in the north, Ol Pejeta's rhino sanctuary, the Masai Mara and Amboseli, with two nights in each.

Flights link the parks, with one short road transfer from Samburu to Ol Pejeta, so you spend your time with the animals.

Why choose this Kenya fly-in safari?

  • Samburu: the Special Five and riverside leopards.
  • Ol Pejeta: black and white rhinos in one of Kenya's top rhino sanctuaries.
  • Masai Mara: big cats and the migration in season.
  • Amboseli: elephants with Kilimanjaro behind them.

Where you stay

Ashnil Samburu Camp, Sweetwaters Serena Camp at Ol Pejeta, Mara Serena Safari Lodge and Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya fly-in safari

June to October is dry and excellent, with the migration in the Mara from July. January to March is also very good, with fewer visitors.

Short on time? See our Samburu and Masai Mara fly-in safari. Browse all flight packages or Kenya safaris. Learn more from the Kenya Wildlife Service.

How much does the Kenya fly-in safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: How do I travel between the parks?
faq.a: By scheduled light aircraft, plus a two to three hour road transfer from Samburu to Ol Pejeta.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on the Kenya fly-in safari?
faq.a: Ashnil Samburu Camp, Sweetwaters Serena Camp, Mara Serena Safari Lodge and Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar.

faq.q: Can I start from the coast?
faq.a: Yes. We can fly you from Mombasa or Diani to Nairobi to connect with the first flight, and back at the end.
It is optional at Ol Pejeta and can be added.

faq.q: Is this safari good for families?
faq.a: Yes. Short flights and two nights in each place make it relaxed for children.
Yes. We recommend Flying Doctors evacuation cover for every safari and can arrange it for you.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Nairobi to Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning flight from Wilson Airport to Samburu. Afternoon game drive. Overnight at Ashnil Samburu Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Full day in Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives along the Ewaso Ng'iro River.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Samburu to Ol Pejeta
itinerary.content: Road transfer of two to three hours to Ol Pejeta Conservancy, with an afternoon game drive. Overnight at Sweetwaters Serena Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Ol Pejeta Conservancy
itinerary.content: Visit the rhino sanctuary and look for lions and elephants. Optional chimpanzee sanctuary visit.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Fly from Ol Pejeta to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Fly to the Mara via Nairobi and enjoy an afternoon game drive. Overnight at Mara Serena Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Full day in the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Game drives with a bush lunch. Optional balloon flight or Maasai visit.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Fly from the Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then fly to Amboseli via Nairobi. Overnight at Ol Tukai Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Full day in Amboseli
itinerary.content: Sunrise drive for Kilimanjaro, Observation Hill and an afternoon drive.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Early game drive and a flight to Wilson Airport, or a connecting flight to the coast.
